activation_condition: Execute only if the semantic-validating Explorer V0.1B run ends TECHNICAL_BLOCKED without a PASS/FAIL schema adjudication.
purpose: Determine whether official Hyperliquid historical node data exposes a deterministic native validator-oracle update schema around the same frozen historical boundary, without opening oracle numeric values or any economic outcome.

frozen_target.time_scope: Only records needed to establish schema and deterministic temporal coverage around the frozen target boundary; no adaptive date selection based on economic values.

allowed_outputs: whether a native-oracle-related schema is visible
forbidden_outputs: HIP-3 deployer-oracle substitution for native BTC/ETH validator oracle

decision_rule.PASS_NATIVE_ORACLE_SCHEMA_CANDIDATE: Official node-history data exposes an unambiguous native-validator-oracle-related action/schema with sufficient timestamp/ordering information to justify a separately frozen deterministic reconstruction audit.
decision_rule.FAIL_NO_NATIVE_ORACLE_SCHEMA_VISIBLE: The conditional source probe completes over the frozen target scope but exposes no native-validator-oracle-related schema. This source path cannot support reconstruction.
decision_rule.TECHNICAL_BLOCKED: Official S3 access/auth/requester-pays, object availability, decompression, or schema parsing prevents a complete source-only adjudication.
